For three decades, it has been a preferred choice for heads of state, diplomatic delegations, business travellers and leisure guests. Defined by classic, refined architecture, Hanoi Daewoo Hotel brings together timeless elegance and attentive service. With modern facilities and 16 sophisticated meeting spaces, the hotel is an ideal destination for major conferences, international events and large-scale weddings. With 411 well-appointed rooms, 6 premium dining venues, relaxing wellness facilities, expansive gardens and the city’s largest outdoor swimming pool, Hanoi Daewoo Hotel promises guests a memorable stay. 411 Rooms & Suites 16 Function rooms & Event spaces 6 F&B outlets Accommodations With 411 elegantly appointed rooms and suites, Hanoi Daewoo Hotel offers a refined stay in the heart of the capital. Meeting Rooms Set the stage for memorable events at one of Hanoi’s landmark hotels, with 14 well-appointed meeting and event venues across the lobby and 3rd floors. The centerpiece is a sparkling 65m infinity pool Lake View Hall For elevated networking events or exclusive celebrations, Lake View Hall on the top floor presents a sophisticated setting for up to 100 guests, complemented by panoramic skyline views of Hanoi. Weddings Mark the beginning of your next chapter at one of Hanoi’s most established wedding destinations. Featuring elegant indoor venues and romantic outdoor settings, Hanoi Daewoo Hotel creates memorable celebrations brought to life with decades of hospitality expertise and personalized service. Grand Ballroom The magnificent Grand Ballroom provides an exceptional setting for lavish wedding celebrations of up to 420 guests. Showcasing soaring ceilings, opulent chandeliers and a grand pillar-free design, it stands among the finest hotel ballrooms in the heritage capital. Serenity Poolside Surrounded by lush gardens and the hotel's iconic pool, Serenity offers a picturesque outdoor setting for weddings and celebrations. Blending natural beauty with refined elegance, it creates a perfect backdrop for your most cherished moments.
